## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed claim cites a source and says where in it the claim appears.
- [ ] Unknown values are `not_documented` / `not_verified` / `unknown`, never zero or a guess.
- [ ] No raw dataset files, patient information or secrets. Previews are compressed WebP with a sample record;
      paper figures only from CC BY or CC0 papers, with their credit.
- [ ] I did not set `approvedBy`, `approvedOn`, `permissionApprovedBy`, `permissionApprovedOn` or
      `catalogStatus: published`, and did not edit `src/data/curators.yaml`.
- [ ] `npm run validate`, `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass; `npm run test:browser` too if a page
      or component changed.
